name: ATtiny25/45/85 (8-pin AVR)
source: Microchip ATtiny25/45/85 datasheet (pinout, alternate functions, reset); hand-transcribed, check against the datasheet of the exact part

not_covered.why: only the 8-pin ATtiny25/45/85 table is shipped; other AVR parts have different pins and alternate functions

enable.unconnected_why: the pin has an internal pull-up of about 30-60 kΩ, but noise can reset the chip
enable.no_pullup_why: it relies on the weak internal pull-up
enable.advice: Pull RESET up to the supply with 10 kΩ (the usual ISP header wiring); if PB5 is used as a GPIO the RSTDISBL fuse disables ISP programming.

5.note: RESET / ADC0: a GPIO only with the RSTDISBL fuse, which disables ISP
